items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: So it’s the two of us with Jerry Bergonzi as our special guest. Mike Fahn on valve trombone and Austin McMahon on drums.

ctx.x: Do you have coming next projects in mind?

Yeah. Well I just put this record out and I did it in a different way. It’s on YouTube so I can tell you’ve been checking it out. It’s free on YouTube and there’s a whole series with it. It’s still dropping over the summer. It’ll still be there. It’s also on vinyl so I thought let’s do this, which is doing well, it’s actually selling really well. And digital downloads through me. So I said hey I want to take back control of this. There’s one tune, “Block Up” is streaming so you can get that on iTunes and stuff.…
It’s wonderful when you find — how many saxophone players are there out there — and you find someone who in particular plays your music in ways that you hadn’t even imagined.
